newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Cebu Property Ventures jumps in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Cebu Property Ventures jumps in late trade.

text.p: Shares of Cebu Property Ventures and Development Corp surged 34 centavos, or 25 percent, to 1.70 pesos in late Tuesday trade on news Ayala Land Inc bought shares of the company at a price above its trading price, brokers said.
"Ayala Land purchased the shares for 1.90 pesos and its moving Cebu Property stocks," said Joey Roxas, president at Eagle Equities Inc.
Cebu Property said on Tuesday Ayala Land bought 76 million shares of Cebu Property from the Cebu provincial government for a total of 144 million pesos.
The purchase gives Ayala Land a direct stake in Cebu Property although its affiliate Cebu Holdings Inc already owned 76 percent of the company.
Cebu Property is developing a 24-hectare business district in the central province of Cebu.
